correctness.rationale: Original RESULT correctly splits N(p)N(q) into EE,FF,EF,FE products. EE<=D by Euclidean parallelogram; FF<=D since F(x)^2+F(y)^2<=D. For mixed EF, optimize the quadratic minorant N(z)^2 >= Aθ z1²+θ z2², Aθ=λ²-(λ²-1)θ, to derive ratio <=λ/sqrt(Aθθ). Maximizing Aθθ on θ∈[0,1] yields λ for 1<λ<=sqrt2, then 2sqrt(1−λ^-2). Direct pairs attain each bound. Equality tracing gives a low-λ continuous orthogonal family, transition α=π/4, high-λ unique circle/strip transition orbit. λ→1 excluded and λ=sqrt2 checked in both formulas.
residual_risks: The complete equality-family argument uses simultaneous saturation in the mixed branch; the finite numerical explorations in provenance are not used as proof.
